initiatives.name: Growth and Efficiency Transformation Programme
initiatives.summary: Croda launched a comprehensive transformation programme to reduce costs by ~£100m for full year 2028, focusing on optimising supply chain, simplifying organisation, and improving efficiency. The programme delivered £28m gross benefits in 2025 at a cash cost of £26m taken as exceptional items.

evidence.title: New CFO Appointment
evidence.summary: Stephen Oxley was appointed as Chief Financial Officer in April 2025, bringing extensive experience in strategy development, business performance, and transformation. He has played a key role in implementing the sales growth and efficiency transformation programme.
evidence.quote: In April, we were delighted to welcome our new CFO, Stephen Oxley. Stephen brings extensive experience in strategy development and execution, driving business performance, and transformation.

evidence.title: Leverage AI Data and Digitalisation Initiative

evidence.title: Headcount Reduction Programme
evidence.summary: Croda reduced headcount by 5% (excluding F&F) and streamlined management layers as part of the transformation programme. This is part of broader efforts to simplify the organisation and realign the cost base.
evidence.quote: Streamlined management layers • Reduced headcount by 5% (ex. F&F) • Zero-based budget of indirect costs

evidence.title: UK Distribution Centre Exit
evidence.summary: Croda is exiting a UK distribution centre as part of streamlining the business and supply chain optimisation. This forms part of the transformation programme to deliver enhanced customer service and optimise distribution costs.
evidence.quote: Other impairments, as outlined in the Finance review, principally related to stopping certain inflight capital programmes and the exit of a UK distribution centre as we streamline the Business and tighten discipline.

evidence.title: Revalidated Science-based Net Zero Targets to 2050
evidence.summary: Croda has updated and strengthened its climate commitments with Science Based Target Initiative validation for more ambitious GHG reduction targets by 2030 and net zero by 2050. The company aims for 42% reduction in scope 1&2 emissions, 25% reduction in scope 3 E&I emissions, and 30.3% reduction in scope 3 FLAG emissions by 2030.
evidence.quote: In 2025, the Science Based Target Initiative (SBTi) validated that our more ambitious, science-based greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets conform with the SBTi Net Zero Standard and the SBTi Forest, Land and Agriculture Guidance. By the end of 2030 we aim to: • reduce absolute scope 1 and 2 green house gas (GHG) emissions by 42% – emissions from our own operations • reduce absolute scope 3 GHG emissions by 25% – E&I value chain emissions upstream and downstream • reduce absolute scope 3 FLAG GHG emissions by 30.3% – land-related emissions upstream

initiatives.name: Lamar Lipids Facility Standby
initiatives.summary: Croda decided to place the Lamar lipids facility in the USA on standby, resulting in non-cash exceptional charges totalling £60.5m. This decision minimises future costs while enabling fulfillment of pandemic-preparedness commitments to the US Government.

initiatives.name: Climate Nature People Positive Commitment
initiatives.summary: Croda has updated its sustainability commitment from 'Climate, Land and People Positive' to 'Climate, Nature and People Positive' by 2030, reflecting advanced understanding of nature's role. The company is focusing on fewer corporate targets for deeper impact in sustainable supply chains, transformational innovation, and positive impacts.

evidence.title: Updated Commitment to Climate Nature People Positive
evidence.summary: Croda has updated its sustainability commitment from 'Climate, Land and People Positive' to 'Climate, Nature and People Positive' by 2030, reflecting advanced understanding of nature's role. The company is focusing on fewer corporate targets for deeper impact in sustainable supply chains, transformational innovation, and positive impacts.
evidence.quote: When Croda launched our Commitment to become Climate, Land and People Positive in 2020, we were one of the first chemical companies to recognise our responsibility for impacts on nature: Land Positive connected our bio-based raw materials with our Croda Agriculture technologies. Since then, our understanding of the role that business plays in contributing to a Nature Positive world has advanced. To reflect this, we have updated our Commitment to become Climate, Nature and People Positive by 2030.
